name: Sofia Novak
education: M.S. in Distributed Systems, Oregon State University
summary: Systems Architect with 6 years of experience designing distributed, event-driven systems on Kubernetes. Strong on system design and horizontal scalability for streaming workloads, with a growing focus on database topology and security architecture.
strengths: Solid distributed systems and scalability design for Kafka-based streaming
Leads system design reviews for high-concurrency services
gaps: Database design depth is limited; relies on managed storage rather than custom topologies
Security experience is operational, not architecture-level threat modeling
resumeText: Sofia Novak is a Systems Architect at Halcyon Compute with six years of experience. She designs distributed, event-driven systems on Kubernetes and Kafka, with a focus on horizontal scalability. Her database and security architecture skills are still developing, which she is actively rounding out in her current role.
